components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Ink fill, turns signal orange on hover.

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Transparent, inverts to ink on hover.

components.description: Mono command with an ink copy button.

components.description: Blocked is solid ink; asked is hatched ink.

components.description: One square per incident; selected tile gets an orange inset ring.

components.name: Chapter Disclosure
components.description: Native details with a border-built chevron.
components.css: .ds-all{border-top:2px solid #0d0e10;border-bottom:2px solid #0d0e10}.ds-all summary{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.8rem;padding-block:1.3rem;font:700 1.2rem Archivo,Arial,sans-serif;font-stretch:94%;cursor:pointer;list-style:none}.ds-all summary::before{content:'';width:9px;height:9px;border-right:2px solid currentColor;border-bottom:2px solid currentColor;transform:rotate(-45deg);transition:transform .32s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-all[open] summary::before{transform:rotate(45deg)}

narrative.overview: The page is a piece of evidence with one visible thread: cold light ground, black ink, one signal orange that connects the text an agent read to the action it took. Flat, ruled, no cards; verdicts are shapes, not colours.
keyCharacteristics: Cold paper, near-black ink, one orange
Verdicts are solid (blocked) and hatched (asked) ink
Archivo width axis for hierarchy, Martian Mono for data only
One motion idea: the thread draws once

rules.name: The Thread Rule
rules.body: Signal orange marks the link from source to action and nothing else.

rules.name: The Shape-Not-Colour Rule
rules.body: Landing-page verdicts are solid or hatched ink, never green/amber/red.

rules.name: The Orange Text Rule
rules.body: Orange text uses the signal-text value.

rules.name: The One Field Rule
rules.body: The install chapter is the only full orange field.

rules.name: The Width-Axis Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from font-stretch stops: 78, 88-94, 100, mono 80.

rules.name: The Mono-Is-Data Rule
rules.body: Martian Mono only for code, counts, axes, tallies, chips.

rules.name: The Flat-Content Rule
rules.body: No shadowed cards; the code panel shadow is the single exception.

dos: Do use ink for everything and orange only for threads, rules, evidence highlights, the selected ring and the install field.
Do draw verdicts as solid ink (blocked) and hatched ink (asked).
Do keep hidden starting states under .js plus .is-armed.
Do carry dynamic values with classes, never inline styles.
donts: Don't put orange on body text.
Don't reintroduce green/amber/red verdicts on the landing page.
Don't wrap content in shadowed cards.
Don't add style attributes or style blocks (CSP).
